faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: All you need to know before getting started.
faq.a1: We support WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram, and CSV/TXT file formats. Simply export your chat history and upload it to our platform.
faq.q2: How accurate is the AI analysis?
faq.a2: Our AI uses advanced natural language processing to provide highly accurate sentiment analysis, behavioral insights, and conversation summaries. The accuracy improves with longer conversation threads.
faq.q3: Can I export the analysis reports?
faq.a3: Yes! You can export your analysis as PDF reports, Markdown files, or structured FAQs. All exports are ready to share with your team or clients.
faq.a4: Absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption and never store your conversations permanently. Your data is processed securely and can be deleted at any time.
faq.a5: Yes, we support Arabic, English, Turkish, Spanish, French, and Hindi with precise cross-language analysis capabilities.
